verdict.rationale: Devin's docs clearly show multiple built-in delegation channels (web app, Slack/Teams, CLI, IDE, API, MCP) letting users hand off coding tasks to the agent, which is core to the product. However, community evidence highlights significant caveats about real-world reliability (e.g., only 13.8% of issues resolved in demo, mismatched job outcomes, skepticism about 'AI Software Engineer' framing), suggesting delegation works as a mechanism but execution quality is inconsistent.
